business_summary: Worthington Enterprises, Inc. operates as an industrial manufacturing company. It operates through two segments, Consumer Products and Building Products. The Consumer Products segment provides products in the tools, outdoor living, and celebrations. Its products include hand-held torches, micro torches, lighters, accessories, and fuel for constructing, fixing making, and creating; precision and specialty hand, digital, and safety tools; drywall tools and accessories used for finishing and taping, cutting, siding, and roofing; propane-filled cylinders for torches, camping stoves and other applications, helium-filled balloon kits, and gas grills and pizza ovens. This segment sells its products primarily to mass merchandisers, retailers, and distributors under the Balloon Time, Bernzomatic, Coleman, Garden-Weasel, General, Halo, Hawkeye, Level5, Mag-Torch, Pactool International, and Worthington Pro Grade brand names. The Building Products segment provides pressurized containment solutions, such as refrigerant gas cylinders used in holding refrigerant gases for commercial, residential, and automotive air conditioning, and refrigeration systems; liquefied petroleum gas cylinders that holds fuel for residential and light commercial heating systems, barbeque grills and recreational vehicle equipment, industrial forklifts, and commercial/residential cooking; well water and expansion tanks used primarily in the residential and commercial markets; specialty products, including various fire suppression tanks, chemical tanks, and foam and adhesive tanks; and ceiling suspension systems and light gauge metal framing products. The company was formerly known as Worthington Industries, Inc. Worthington Enterprises, Inc. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.
business_summary_ko: Worthington Enterprises, Inc.는 산업 제조 회사로 운영됩니다. 소비자 제품과 건축 제품이라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 소비재 부문은 도구, 야외 생활 및 축하 행사에 제품을 제공합니다. 해당 제품에는 휴대용 토치, 마이크로 토치, 라이터, 액세서리 및 건설, 고정 제작 및 제작용 연료가 포함됩니다. 정밀 및 특수 수작업, 디지털 및 안전 도구; 마무리 및 테이핑, 절단, 사이딩 및 루핑에 사용되는 건식 벽체 도구 및 액세서리; 토치용 프로판 충전 실린더, 캠핑 스토브 및 기타 용도, 헬륨 충전 풍선 키트, 가스 그릴 및 피자 오븐. 이 부문은 주로 Balloon Time, Bernzomatic, Coleman, Garden-Weasel, General, Halo, Hawkeye, Level5, Mag-Torch, Pactool International 및 Worthington Pro Grade 브랜드 이름으로 대량 판매업자, 소매업자 및 유통업자에게 제품을 판매합니다. 건축 제품 부문은 상업용, 주거용, 자동차 에어컨 및 냉동 시스템용 냉매 가스를 보관하는 데 사용되는 냉매 가스 실린더와 같은 가압 봉쇄 솔루션을 제공합니다. 액화석유가스 실린더
